title: Lovely experience in Gracia ☺️
text: I went with some friends to Barcelona for a bachelorette and booking this experience really made the travel even more special!! Shamine guided us through the lovely streets of Gracia and the bars we went to were top notch. Thank you Shamine for your kindness ❤️!
author: judith746

title: Great host, great value, great fun!!
text: If you want to see the real Barcelona, book this tour. We loved wandering through the small plazas and hearing the stories behind the neighborhood while stopping for amazing tapas and wine. The pace was relaxed and authentic, and we appreciated discovering an area that still feels genuinely local
author: 52devindrar

title: Great experience, feels like I’m with a local amigo
text: “This ended up being our favorite experience in Barcelona. Gràcia felt completely different from the crowded tourist areas — relaxed, beautiful, and full of local life. The tapas spots were places we never would have found ourselves, and the wine was excellent. It felt more like exploring with a local friend than being on a tour.”
author: J9544KRkevinh

title: Fun evening rediscovering Gracia
text: This was an absolute fun evening. Our guide was fun and passionate about the neighborhood.  We explored beautiful tucked away corners of Gracia I had completely forgotten about. It felt like seeing the city through fresh eyes. If you want an authentic experience in Barcelona, don’t miss this!
author: DixieLorillee
